initial:
Edit the supplied game sprite sheet to produce a corrective supplemental sprite sheet of the SAME yellow laughing frog character. Preserve its glossy soft 3D cartoon identity, gray mitten hands and gray feet, cream belly, closed laughing eyes, open laughing mouth, body proportions, lighting and clean alpha edges. Transparent background. All characters face SCREEN RIGHT in exactly the original three-quarter side view; game mirrors them later. No text, no grid lines, no blood, no detached limbs.
Output a 1536x1024 atlas with EXACTLY FOUR ROWS and FIVE equally spaced column positions. Each cell 307x256. Keep every sprite entirely inside its cell with at least 20px transparent margins. Consistent standing height about 200px, feet baseline at row bottom minus 20px. Empty fifth cell in first two rows.
ROW 1: FOUR healthy walking frames, both hands intact. Frames 1 and 3 step forward with the NEAR LEG (camera-facing leg visibly in foreground); frames 2 and 4 step forward with the FAR LEG, reversing the two feet's front/back positions. Thus NEAR step, FAR step, NEAR step, FAR step, never repeating the same stepping leg consecutively including loop boundary. Poses 1/3 and 2/4 subtly differ in body bounce but must be unambiguously alternate feet. Fixed torso facing direction, do not mirror the whole body.
ROW 2: FOUR injured walking frames corresponding EXACTLY to row 1's foot poses and body scale. The CAMERA-FACING NEAR ARM is amputated: the big arm rooted on the screen-left/front side of the visible cream belly ends in a smooth short rounded yellow stump at shoulder level, completely lacking forearm and gray glove. The FAR ARM, rooted on the screen-right side nearer the mouth, remains intact with ONE gray glove. The rounded stump MUST be clearly visible in front of the torso in ALL injured frames. This same physical near arm stays absent regardless of pose.
ROW 3: FIVE injured biting/punching frames: far fist near chest, far arm extends halfway, far arm reaches forward, far arm retracts halfway, far fist returns near chest. Only ONE gray glove, on the intact FAR ARM throughout. The NEAR ARM remains the same clearly visible rounded stump in ALL FIVE frames including the last frame. Do not swap the missing side at any point. Head/body remain right-facing.
ROW 4: FIVE injured death frames: injured upright leaning forward, injured knees buckling and torso pitching forward, injured falling forward, injured lying face-down, injured lying completely still on side/face-down. Fall to screen RIGHT, maintaining the same size as standing character. NEAR ARM stump remains clearly visible toward camera in every frame, including both prone frames; exactly ONE far gray glove can be visible near the face, never add a foreground hand to the stump. Keep legs connected to body, no extra frog, no detached limb. Every frame a single isolated sprite with transparent separation.
Highest priority: correct near/far limb continuity, alternating walk legs, NO regeneration of the amputated hand at last attack/death frames.
